title: Reading Drill — Opening a Second Door at a Library
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Opening a Second Door at a Library
passages.body:
**A** A town library tested opening a second door at closing time. Its manager was interested in how visitors passed the returns desk when both doors were available.

**B** The exit queue shortened, but more people passed the desk without seeing where to return books. Staff put a second sign where both lines of visitors could see it.

**C** The library kept the experiment limited to weekdays. A Saturday assistant asked to repeat the trial when families usually brought more items per visit.

questions.prompt: Its manager was interested in how visitors passed the ______ when both doors were available.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Its manager was interested in how visitors passed the returns desk when both doors were available.

questions.prompt: Staff put a second ______ where both lines of visitors could see it.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Staff put a second sign where both lines of visitors could see it.

questions.prompt: A Saturday assistant asked to repeat the trial when families usually brought more ______ per visit.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: A Saturday assistant asked to repeat the trial when families usually brought more items per visit.

questions.prompt: Increasing the number of exits completely solved the book returns issue.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The exit queue shortened, but more people passed the desk without seeing where to return books. Staff put a second sign where both lines of visitors could see it.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph mentions an explanation of why a different day might give different results?
questions.explanation: The library kept the experiment limited to weekdays. A Saturday assistant asked to repeat the trial when families usually brought more items per visit.
